meta.title: Lady Buddha Vietnam 🇻🇳 | Da Nang’s Most Iconic Attraction
meta.description:
Interested in exploring the Lady Buddha in Da Nang, one of the most iconic and peaceful places in Central Vietnam? 

Located on the stunning Son Tra Peninsula Vietnam alongside the pristine Linh Ung Pagoda Da Nang, this massive statue overlooks the coastline and offers some of the BEST viewpoints in Da Nang Vietnam.

If you’re wondering: Is the Lady Buddha Da Nang worth visiting? ABSOLUTELY IT IS! Come along as we cover what to do on Son Tra Peninsula with our honest Linh Ung Pagoda and Lady Buddha review for our Vietnam travel vlog.

In this video, we take you around these two must see Da Nang attractions, walk the beautiful temple grounds, and share what makes this spot a MUST-VISIT when traveling to Vietnam and planning your Da Nang itinerary must see places. From towering statues and ocean views to hidden corners of the peninsula, this is one stop you don’t want to miss.

If you're planning a trip to Vietnam, this Da Nang travel guide 2026 will help you decide if visiting the Lady Buddha is worth it as one of the top things to do in Da Nang.

📍 What you’ll see in this video:
* The famous Lady Buddha statue (67m tall!)
* Linh Ung Pagoda and surrounding temples
* Scenic views from Son Tra Peninsula
* Tips for visiting (timing, dress code, getting there)

💡 Travel Tips:
* Visit early morning or late afternoon for fewer crowds
* Dress modestly (this is an active place of worship)
* Combine with a Son Tra Peninsula drive for epic views

📌 Why visit the Lady Buddha?This is one of the most important spiritual sites in Da Nang and offers a unique mix of culture, nature, and incredible coastal scenery - all for FREE!!!
